documents.text:
# RAG Storage

Metadata is stored in SQLite. Dense embeddings use a local vector index.

## Verification

Every chunk retains a stable document identifier and a canonical source span.

## Unicode

Chinese examples use Unicode character offsets rather than byte positions.

API responses contain JSON provenance records.
Retry budgets limit remote model calls.
Failed model proposals fall back to deterministic splitting.
